text_block_list.text:
Finally, it's time for Haru Urara's debut 
race.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Urara debut～♪ Urara debut♪ It's time for 
the debut～!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's because I can finally make my debut! 
Debuting is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
When I make my debut, I'll be able to run 
a lot more than now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I love running! That's why I'm so happy～!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I feel like I've become much 
stronger than before!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I had a lot of matches with the trainer, 
and I didn't lose even once!

If the result of our races gave her 
confidence, then the days of sore muscles 
will be worth it…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm sure I'll be able to get 
first place today!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll definitely get the first place! 
Time to go!
